import html # Pre‑defined HTML template with placeholders for title and body. BLOG_FORMAT = """

{title}

{body}
""" def format_post_content(post_title: str, post_body: str) -> str: """ Sanitize and format a blog post for safe HTML display. Args: post_title: The headline or title of the blog post. post_body: The full text content of the blog post. Returns: A string containing a well‑formed HTML snippet ready for rendering. """ # Escape any potentially malicious content to prevent XSS. safe_title = html.escape(post_title, quote=True) safe_body = html.escape(post_body, quote=True) # Insert the sanitized values into the template. formatted = BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_title, body=safe_body) return formatted
